summary: Dolby Laboratories filed an 8-K furnishing quarterly results and announcing a $0.36 per share cash dividend payable August 19, 2026 to holders of record August 11, 2026, alongside an increase in its share repurchase authorization by $350 million, bringing available repurchases to approximately $427 million. Repurchases will be made through open market or negotiated transactions, shares retired, and the program has no expiration date. The actions signal management's confidence and commitment to returning capital to shareholders. Watch for ongoing buyback execution pace and any shifts in capital allocation policy.
